library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

sample_metadta <- read.csv("/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/metadata/sample_meta_with_hrp_status_updated.csv")
print(colnames(sample_metadta))

ir_metadata <- sample_metadta%>%
    select(Sample,site,hrp_status)%>%
    rename("iid"="Sample","group"="hrp_status","fid"="site")
write.csv(ir_metadata,"/mnt/storage13/ahri/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/all_country_merged/WGS_Pf_Ethiopia_2024/isorelate/ir_metadata_hrp_status.csv",row.names=F)
